notes: Self-declared "puzzle and adventure game", and exploring a Zelda-inspired world is what the sentence is about, so Adventure leads on world-open, which the author confirmed as one continuous walkable landmass with the castle at its centre - no P4 and no biome split. It was close with Puzzle, named first by the author and owning nine gating puzzles, so Puzzle is secondary for facade-clue (the clues the prompt places beside each puzzle); RPG is the third name only because the shops, the bounded monster patrols and the mob points have no home in Adventure or Puzzle, and dropping it would lose hazard-aggro, spawner-npc and the enterable shop row. Took the Quest Hub preset on its own shape but dropped tracker-quest and teleporter-link, which the prompt never asks for, and used gate-progression for both the castle gate and the arena that seals until its monsters are cleared. P3 is required rather than assumed - shops are bought from and the boss sits inside the castle - and I am flagging that P3 is not shipping yet; the mountain setting makes terrain-relief tiered, and water-body is the lake and coast read as a grounded shoreline, so its CHECK resolves clean. Decided without a user: three puzzles per biome with one key puzzle each gating the castle, weapons and heart rewards as collectible-nodes in alcove-secret hiding places, and hearts, currency values and enemy AI treated as mechanics outside layout scope.
